name: Stomatal Apparatus (Open & Closed Guard Cells)
semanticDescription: Microscopic leaf stomatal apparatus illustrating paired bean-shaped guard cells with differential inner/outer wall thickness, chloroplasts, stomatal aperture, and surrounding epidermal pavement cells (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.3).
simplifications: Differential wall elasticity illustrated via thicker concave inner boundary mesh.
Chloroplasts shown as distinct green lens-shaped organelles within guard cell cytoplasm.

materials.look: Thick rigid cellulose inner wall lining (deep emerald green)
Vibrant photosynthetic chloroplast granules (bright grass green)
Pavement epidermal cells with light translucent cellular matrix
